verses.en: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.
verses.pt: Se alguém furtar um boi (ou uma ovelha), e o matar ou vender, por um boi pagará cinco bois, e por uma ovelha quatro ovelhas.
verses.en_web: “If a man steals an ox or a sheep, and kills it, or sells it; he shall pay five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.
verses.en_bbe: If a man takes without right another man's ox or his sheep, and puts it to death or gets a price for it, he is to give five oxen for an ox, or four sheep for a sheep, in payment: the thief will have to make payment for what he has taken; if he has no money, he himself will have to be exchanged for money, so that payment may be made.

verses.en: If a thief be found breaking up, and be smitten that he die, there shall no blood be shed for him.
verses.pt: Se o ladrão for achado a minar uma casa, e for ferido de modo que morra, o que o feriu não será réu de sangue;
verses.en_web: If the thief is found breaking in, and is struck so that he dies, there shall be no guilt of bloodshed for him.
verses.en_bbe: If a thief is taken in the act of forcing his way into a house, and his death is caused by a blow, the owner of the house is not responsible for his blood.

verses.en: If the sun be risen upon him, there shall be blood shed for him; for he should make full restitution; if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.
verses.pt: mas se o sol houver saído sobre o ladrão, o que o feriu será réu de sangue. O ladrão certamente dará indenização; se nada possuir, será então vendido por seu furto.
verses.en_web: If the sun has risen on him, guilt of bloodshed shall be for him; he shall make restitution. If he has nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.
verses.en_bbe: But if it is after dawn, he will be responsible.

verses.en: If the theft be certainly found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep; he shall restore double.
verses.pt: Se o furto for achado vivo na sua mão, seja boi, ou jumento, ou ovelha, pagará ele o dobro.
verses.en_web: If the stolen property is found in his hand alive, whether it is ox, donkey, or sheep, he shall pay double.
verses.en_bbe: If he still has what he had taken, whatever it is, ox or ass or sheep, he is to give twice its value.

verses.en: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his beast, and shall feed in another man’s field; of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard, shall he make restitution.
verses.pt: Se alguém fizer pastar o seu animal num campo ou numa vinha, e se soltar o seu animal e este pastar no campo de outrem, do melhor do seu próprio campo e do melhor da sua própria vinha fará restituição.
verses.en_web: “If a man causes a field or vineyard to be eaten, and lets his animal loose, and it grazes in another man’s field, he shall make restitution from the best of his own field, and from the best of his own vineyard.
verses.en_bbe: If a man makes a fire in a field or a vine-garden, and lets the fire do damage to another man's field, he is to give of the best produce of his field or his vine-garden to make up for it.

verses.en: If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field, be consumed therewith; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.
verses.pt: Se alastrar um fogo e pegar nos espinhos, de modo que sejam destruídas as medas de trigo, ou a seara, ou o campo, aquele que acendeu o fogo certamente dará, indenização.
verses.en_web: “If fire breaks out, and catches in thorns so that the shocks of grain, or the standing grain, or the field are consumed; he who kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.
verses.en_bbe: If there is a fire and the flames get to the thorns at the edge of the field, causing destruction of the cut grain or of the living grain, or of the field, he who made the fire will have to make up for the damage.

verses.en: If a man shall deliver unto his neighbour money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man’s house; if the thief be found, let him pay double.
verses.pt: Se alguém entregar ao seu próximo dinheiro, ou objetos, para guardar, e isso for furtado da casa desse homem, o ladrão, se for achado, pagará o dobro.
verses.en_web: “If a man delivers to his neighbor money or stuff to keep, and it is stolen out of the man’s house; if the thief is found, he shall pay double.
verses.en_bbe: If a man puts money or goods in the care of his neighbour to keep for him, and it is taken from the man's house, if they get the thief, he will have to make payment of twice the value.

verses.en: If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall be brought unto the judges, to see whether he have put his hand unto his neighbour’s goods.
verses.pt: Se o ladrão não for achado, então o dono da casa irá à presença dos juizes para se verificar se não meteu a mão nos bens do seu próximo.
verses.en_web: If the thief isn’t found, then the master of the house shall come near to God, to find out if he hasn’t put his hand to his neighbor’s goods.
verses.en_bbe: If they do not get the thief, let the master of the house come before the judges and take an oath that he has not put his hand on his neighbour's goods.

verses.en: For all manner of trespass, whether it be for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment, or for any manner of lost thing, which another challengeth to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges; and whom the judges shall condemn, he shall pay double unto his neighbour.
verses.pt: Em todo caso de transgressão, seja a respeito de boi, ou de jumento, ou de ovelhas, ou de vestidos, ou de qualquer coisa perdida de que alguém disser que é sua, a causa de ambas as partes será levada perante os juízes; aquele a quem os juízes condenarem pagará o dobro ao seu próximo.
verses.en_web: For every matter of trespass, whether it is for ox, for donkey, for sheep, for clothing, or for any kind of lost thing, about which one says, ‘This is mine,’ the cause of both parties shall come before God. He whom God condemns shall pay double to his neighbor.
verses.en_bbe: In any question about an ox or an ass or a sheep or clothing, or about the loss of any property which anyone says is his, let the two sides put their cause before God; and he who is judged to be in the wrong is to make payment to his neighbour of twice the value.

verses.en: If a man deliver unto his neighbour an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast, to keep; and it die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man seeing it:
verses.pt: Se alguém entregar a seu próximo para guardar um jumento, ou boi, ou ovelha, ou outro qualquer animal, e este morrer, ou for aleijado, ou arrebatado, ninguém o vendo,
verses.en_web: “If a man delivers to his neighbor a donkey, an ox, a sheep, or any animal to keep, and it dies or is injured, or driven away, no man seeing it;
verses.en_bbe: If a man puts an ass or an ox or a sheep or any beast into the keeping of his neighbour, and it comes to death or is damaged or is taken away, without any person seeing it:

verses.en: Then shall an oath of the LORD be between them both, that he hath not put his hand unto his neighbour’s goods; and the owner of it shall accept thereof, and he shall not make it good.
verses.pt: então haverá o juramento do Senhor entre ambos, para ver se o guardador não meteu a mão nos bens do seu próximo; e o dono aceitará o juramento, e o outro não fará restituição.
verses.en_web: the oath of Yahweh shall be between them both, whether he hasn’t put his hand to his neighbor’s goods; and its owner shall accept it, and he shall not make restitution.
verses.en_bbe: If he takes his oath before the Lord that he has not put his hand to his neighbour's goods, the owner is to take his word for it and he will not have to make payment for it.

verses.en: And if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.
verses.pt: Se, porém, o animal lhe tiver sido furtado, fará restituirão ao seu dono.
verses.en_web: But if it is stolen from him, he shall make restitution to its owner.
verses.en_bbe: But if it is taken from him by a thief, he is to make up for the loss of it to its owner.

verses.en: If it be torn in pieces, then let him bring it for witness, and he shall not make good that which was torn.
verses.pt: Se tiver sido dilacerado, trá-lo-á em testemunho disso; não dará indenização pelo dilacerado.
verses.en_web: If it is torn in pieces, let him bring it for evidence. He shall not make good that which was torn.
verses.en_bbe: But if it has been damaged by a beast, and he is able to make this clear, he will not have to make payment for what was damaged.

verses.en: And if a man borrow ought of his neighbour, and it be hurt, or die, the owner thereof being not with it, he shall surely make it good.
verses.pt: Se alguém pedir emprestado a seu próximo algum animal, e este for danificado ou morrer, não estando presente o seu dono, certamente dará indenização;
verses.en_web: “If a man borrows anything of his neighbor’s, and it is injured, or dies, its owner not being with it, he shall surely make restitution.
verses.en_bbe: If a man gets from his neighbour the use of one of his beasts, and it is damaged or put to death when the owner is not with it, he will certainly have to make payment for the loss.

verses.en: But if the owner thereof be with it, he shall not make it good: if it be an hired thing, it came for his hire.
verses.pt: se o dono estiver presente, o outro não dará indenização; se tiver sido alugado, o aluguel responderá por qualquer dano.
verses.en_web: If its owner is with it, he shall not make it good. If it is a leased thing, it came for its lease.
verses.en_bbe: If the owner is with it, he will not have to make payment: if he gave money for the use of it, the loss is covered by the payment.

verses.en: And if a man entice a maid that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely endow her to be his wife.
verses.pt: Se alguém seduzir uma virgem que não for desposada, e se deitar com ela, certamente pagará por ela o dote e a terá por mulher.
verses.en_web: “If a man entices a virgin who isn’t pledged to be married, and lies with her, he shall surely pay a dowry for her to be his wife.
verses.en_bbe: If a man takes a virgin, who has not given her word to another man, and has connection with her, he will have to give a bride-price for her to be his wife.

verses.en: If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.
verses.pt: Se o pai dela inteiramente recusar dar-lha, pagará ele em dinheiro o que for o dote das virgens.
verses.en_web: If her father utterly refuses to give her to him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.
verses.en_bbe: If her father will not give her to him on any account, he will have to give the regular payment for virgins.

verses.en: Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.
verses.pt: Não permitirás que viva uma feiticeira.
verses.en_web: “You shall not allow a sorceress to live.
verses.en_bbe: Any woman using unnatural powers or secret arts is to be put to death.

verses.en: Whosoever lieth with a beast shall surely be put to death.
verses.pt: Todo aquele que se deitar com animal, certamente será morto.
verses.en_web: “Whoever has sex with an animal shall surely be put to death.
verses.en_bbe: Any man who has sex connection with a beast is to be put to death.

verses.en: He that sacrificeth unto any god, save unto the LORD only, he shall be utterly destroyed.
verses.pt: Quem sacrificar a qualquer deus, a não ser tão-somente ao Senhor, será morto.
verses.en_web: “He who sacrifices to any god, except to Yahweh only, shall be utterly destroyed.
verses.en_bbe: Complete destruction will come on any man who makes offerings to any other god but the Lord.

verses.en: Thou shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.pt: Ao estrangeiro não maltratarás, nem o oprimirás; pois vós fostes estrangeiros na terra do Egito.
verses.en_web: “You shall not wrong an alien or oppress him, for you were aliens in the land of Egypt.
verses.en_bbe: Do no wrong to a man from a strange country, and do not be hard on him; for you yourselves were living in a strange country, in the land of Egypt.

verses.en: Ye shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.
verses.pt: A nenhuma viúva nem órfão afligireis.
verses.en_web: “You shall not take advantage of any widow or fatherless child.
verses.en_bbe: Do no wrong to a widow, or to a child whose father is dead.

verses.en: If thou afflict them in any wise, and they cry at all unto me, I will surely hear their cry;
verses.pt: Se de algum modo os afligirdes, e eles clamarem a mim, eu certamente ouvirei o seu clamor;
verses.en_web: If you take advantage of them at all, and they cry at all to me, I will surely hear their cry;
verses.en_bbe: If you are cruel to them in any way, and their cry comes up to me, I will certainly give ear;

verses.en: And my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.
verses.pt: e a minha ira se acenderá, e vos matarei à espada; vossas mulheres ficarão viúvas, e vossos filhos órfãos.
verses.en_web: and my wrath will grow hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.
verses.en_bbe: And in the heat of my wrath I will put you to death with the sword, so that your wives will be widows and your children without fathers.

verses.en: If thou lend money to any of my people that is poor by thee, thou shalt not be to him as an usurer, neither shalt thou lay upon him usury.
verses.pt: Se emprestares dinheiro ao meu povo, ao pobre que está contigo, não te haverás com ele como credor; não lhe imporás juros.
verses.en_web: “If you lend money to any of my people with you who is poor, you shall not be to him as a creditor. You shall not charge him interest.
verses.en_bbe: If you let any of the poor among my people have the use of your money, do not be a hard creditor to him, and do not take interest.

verses.en: If thou at all take thy neighbour’s raiment to pledge, thou shalt deliver it unto him by that the sun goeth down:
verses.pt: Ainda que chegues a tomar em penhor o vestido do teu próximo, lho restituirás antes do pôr do sol;
verses.en_web: If you take your neighbor’s garment as collateral, you shall restore it to him before the sun goes down,
verses.en_bbe: If ever you take your neighbour's clothing in exchange for the use of your money, let him have it back before the sun goes down:

verses.en: For that is his covering only, it is his raiment for his skin: wherein shall he sleep? and it shall come to pass, when he crieth unto me, that I will hear; for I am gracious.
verses.pt: porque é a única cobertura que tem; é o vestido da sua pele; em que se deitaria ele? Quando pois clamar a mim, eu o ouvirei, porque sou misericordioso.
verses.en_web: for that is his only covering, it is his garment for his skin. What would he sleep in? It will happen, when he cries to me, that I will hear, for I am gracious.
verses.en_bbe: For it is the only thing he has for covering his skin; what is he to go to sleep in? and when his cry comes up to me, I will give ear, for my mercy is great.

verses.en: Thou shalt not revile the gods, nor curse the ruler of thy people.
verses.pt: Aos juízes não maldirás, nem amaldiçoarás ao governador do teu povo.
verses.en_web: “You shall not blaspheme God, nor curse a ruler of your people.
verses.en_bbe: You may not say evil of the judges, or put a curse on the ruler of your people.

verses.en: Thou shalt not delay to offer the first of thy ripe fruits, and of thy liquors: the firstborn of thy sons shalt thou give unto me.
verses.pt: Não tardarás em trazer ofertas da tua ceifa e dos teus lagares. O primogênito de teus filhos me darás.
verses.en_web: “You shall not delay to offer from your harvest and from the outflow of your presses. “You shall give the firstborn of your sons to me.
verses.en_bbe: Do not keep back your offerings from the wealth of your grain and your vines. The first of your sons you are to give to me.

verses.en: Likewise shalt thou do with thine oxen, and with thy sheep: seven days it shall be with his dam; on the eighth day thou shalt give it me.
verses.pt: Assim farás com os teus bois e com as tuas ovelhas; sete dias ficará a cria com a mãe; ao oitavo dia ma darás.
verses.en_web: You shall do likewise with your cattle and with your sheep. Seven days it shall be with its mother, then on the eighth day you shall give it to me.
verses.en_bbe: In the same way with your oxen and your sheep: for seven days let the young one be with its mother; on the eighth day give it to me.

verses.en: And ye shall be holy men unto me: neither shall ye eat any flesh that is torn of beasts in the field; ye shall cast it to the dogs.
verses.pt: Ser-me-eis homens santos; portanto não comereis carne que por feras tenha sido despedaçada no campo; aos cães a lançareis.
verses.en_web: “You shall be holy men to me, therefore you shall not eat any meat that is torn by animals in the field. You shall cast it to the dogs.
verses.en_bbe: You are to be holy men to me: the flesh of no animal whose death has been caused by the beasts of the field may be used for your food; it is to be given to the dogs.
